newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 17.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Tuesday:
* The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey implemented new security measures, two months after the crash of TWA Flight 800.

* American military officials were blamed in a Pentagon report for ignoring repeated warnings about terrorits' threats before the explosion at a Saudi Arabian apartment complex in June that killed 19 U.S. military personnel.
* Documents recently declassified show the United States knew immediately after the end of the Korean War that North Korea had failed to turn over hundreds of American prisoners.

* The 1996 presidential campaign shifted to the issue of crime and drug use, as Republican nominee Bob Dole faulted President Clinton for gutting the White House drug policy staff he inherited in 1993.
* McGeorge Bundy, a foreign policy adviser to presidents John Kennedy and Lyndon Johnson and who advocated expanding the U.S. involvment in the Vietnam War, died on Monday at the age of 77.
